measurement_limits: This establishes one campaign case, not cross-session recurrence or average agent intervention burden.
The record schema defect was in authored evidence; the environmental limitation was the absence of a pre-publication contract check when the exact repository data was available.
No causal claim is made about the earlier Btrfs metadata incident.

pressure_hypothesis.actionable_recommendation: Before appending a new Environment observation reference, validate its exact readable blob digest, identity, observation contract, and any append-only correction contract.
pressure_hypothesis.basis: Four immutable campaign observations were accepted into the evidence ledger, then the ECI projection rejected each because recorder was a string. The checkpoint stored pointers and hashes but did not check the readable observation contract before append.
